x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      5G or 6G or B5G or BEMS or RAN or V1G or V2B or V2G or V2H
      or stemmed "5G-Advanced" or stemmed "AI data center"
      or stemmed "AI data centre" or stemmed "EV fleet"
      or stemmed "HVAC flexibility" or stemmed "IMT-2030"
      or stemmed "active building" or stemmed "base station"
      or stemmed "building energy management system"
      or stemmed "building thermal flexibility" or stemmed "cellular network"
      or stemmed "cloud computing facility" or stemmed "data center"
      or stemmed "data centre" or stemmed "edge data center"
      or stemmed "edge data centre" or stemmed "electric vehicle"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive building"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive efficient building"
      or stemmed "high performance computing" or stemmed "radio access network"
      or stemmed "smart building" or stemmed "smart charging"
      or stemmed "telecom tower" or stemmed "vehicle-to-building"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-grid" or stemmed "vehicle-to-home"
    )
    and (
      MPC or stemmed "co-optimization" or stemmed "coordinated control"
      or stemmed "distributed control" or stemmed "integrated energy management"
      or stemmed "measurement and verification"
      or stemmed "model predictive control" or stemmed "multi-asset"
      or aggregation or coordination
    )
    and (
      VPP
      or stemmed "congestion management"
      or stemmed "distribution grid"
      or stemmed "local energy sharing"
      or stemmed "virtual power plant"
      or stemmed "voltage support"
      or microgrid
    )
    and (
      stemmed "cross-sector"
      or stemmed "integrated energy management"
      or stemmed "multi-asset"
      or stemmed "virtual power plant"
    )
  )
